scope.selection: All active types, ordered by distinct active building count ascending, then alphabetically. The same unchanged database snapshot underlies all three batches.

method: One dedicated agent per type inspected saved source descriptions, mappings, comparable categories and current sources. The coordinator reconciled cross-type recommendations. The final 52 reviews explicitly inspected every saved assignment of their type; live checks were exhaustive or attempted for many smaller types and sampled for larger ones. Per-type coverage and caveats distinguish current confirmation, unavailable sources, historical evidence and unvisited assignments. This is a taxonomy audit, not an inspection of facility operation or an exhaustive fresh verification of every property.
